Who We Are
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
 The opportunity
 We are looking for an experienced Auotmation Tester to join our team, to work with cross country collegues and to shape the future of payments industry.
 Day-to-day Responsibilities
Development of Automation Tests in collaboration with colleagues in different countries
Responsibility of full Automatio Test lifecycle
Support and drive analysis and solution of new automation test cases based on requirements and bug fixes
Module, Integration and E2E tests of the software modules in their specific environments
Test Automation of the web GUIs as well MicroServices
Test case creation including test requirements analysis, test case definition, test data creation, test execution and documentation in close consultation with development team
Continuous improvement of automation test framework
Creation and maintenance of consitent data sets in collaboration with other automation testers
Maintenance of automation test environment on different technologies (Google Cloud, Internal Cloud)
Defect logging, reporting and re-testing
Monitoring of the automatic test sequences, including reporting to the development team
Implement quality gates for Continuous Integration/Delivery
 Who Are We Looking For
 We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:
Final degree (university or technical college) in software testing, software engineering or equivalent education
At least four years of experience in software testing of which should be mimimum 2 years in test automation
Knowledge of STLC, Agile Methodology, SOAP/REST,test automation using the Robot framework
Experience in Selenium/ SoapUI, Python,Java, Jira, Confluence
Basic Knowledge of SQL, Linux OS (shell scripting), Continuous Integration/Delivery
Good to have know-how in Groovy, Gradle, Jenkins, Testlink, JMeter/Grinder, RPM, Puppet, Foreman, Git
Experience on the version control tools like gitlab, github
Exposure to CI-CD , dockerization
Able to design the framework , suggest modification in the existing framework.
Experience in fraud detection systems or Payment business major plus
English business fluent
